challenge: NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 - Lunar Landing Site Navigator
scope: Scientific, astronomical, geospatial, mission, PSR, terrain, illumination and derived validation data used by this repository.

entries.description: Sixteen CLPS and historical/reference mission records, payload summaries, dates, target descriptions and coordinate qualifiers.

source.organization: NASA and the primary organizations cited per record
source.title: Per-record source citations in data/missions.json
source.version_or_date: Record-specific; accessed dates are stored per source record.

retrieval.method: Manual curation from the source URLs embedded in each record.

processing.method: Payload fields are transcribed; offline fixtures add explicit unavailable-analysis fields. Coordinates retain coordinate_type and coordinate_provenance.

limitations: Several planned-mission coordinates are NASA destination/region references, not published landing fixes; they are not represented as actual landings.
CP-12 termination is sourced from SpaceNews because the current catalog record has no NASA termination release; this secondary citation requires human review.

entries.description: The intentionally used nine-region October 2024 Artemis III candidate-region set; coordinates are IAU feature-centre anchors, not NASA region centroids or landing points.

source.title: NASA Provides Update on Artemis III Moon Landing Regions (release 24-136)

supplemental_sources.title: Artemis III Site Selection Update: Downselection From Thirteen to Nine Candidate Regions
Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature, Moon centre points

retrieval.date: 2026-11-05 for the pinned USGS archive; NASA publication dates are source dates.
retrieval.method: NASA region names were transcribed; USGS archive was downloaded and filtered to IAU-adopted anchor features.

processing.method: Anchor longitudes are normalized to [-180, 180] and rounded to four decimals; diameters to three decimals; nearby catalog distances use a 1737.4 km spherical haversine calculation.

entries.version_choice: Nine-region October 2024 update, not the original thirteen-region August 2022 list.

entries.dataset: Lunar South Pole permanently shadowed regions
entries.description: NASA PGDA product 90 LPSR 80S 20MPP polygon dataset used for PSR containment, nearest-region distance and area.

source.title: LOLA product 90, LPSR_80S_20MPP_ADJ
source.version_or_date: Filename release LPSR_80S_20MPP_ADJ; exact upstream publication date not stated in repository.

retrieval.date: Manifest verification date is runtime-specific; expected SHA-256 values are in src/acquire/verify_data.py.
retrieval.method: Git LFS or NASA PGDA download via src/acquire/nasa_products.py.

processing.method: Local projected spatial queries, invalid-source-geometry handling, nearest-distance and area calculations; no polygon values are changed.

limitations: The source PRJ and product documentation have different lunar frame descriptions; see docs/SCIENTIFIC_BASIS.md.
PSR host-crater names are not NASA polygon attributes; they are a separate locally filtered USGS/IAU gazetteer join.

entries.dataset: IAU lunar crater and feature names
entries.description: IAU-adopted Moon feature centre points, feature types and diameters used for PSR host names and Artemis anchors.

source.title: Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature, Moon centre points archive

retrieval.method: Downloaded archive, SHA-256 checked, filtered to IAU-adopted crater/satellite features south of 70 degrees latitude.

processing.method: Longitude normalization to [-180, 180], coordinate/diameter rounding, CSV export; PSR host assignment is a local geometric containment/area operation.

entries.description: 80 m/pixel NASA PGDA product 90 terrain used for elevation, slopes and horizon masks in the 80-90 degree south region.

retrieval.date: 2026-10-20 local verification recorded in cache metadata
retrieval.method: Git LFS or verified NASA PGDA download.

processing.method: Raster sampling and horizon ray tracing; CRS and reference-sphere limitations are documented in docs/SCIENTIFIC_BASIS.md.

entries.description: Global LDEM_64 raster used outside the polar DEM and to build committed site tiles.

source.organization: NASA PDS Geosciences Node / LRO LOLA
source.title: LRO-L-LOLA-3-RDR-V1 LDEM_64

retrieval.date: 2026-10-30 local verification recorded in cache metadata
retrieval.method: Verified PDS download; site tiles are generated locally.

processing.method: Global DEM resampling into site-centred stereographic tiles with 1737400 m sphere height reference; tile source identity is recorded in data/lola/tiles/index.json.

entries.description: Product 69 long-term mean visible solar-disc fraction at 85-90S and 75-90S.

retrieval.date: 2026-10-20 local verification recorded for 85S product; manifest checks all files.
retrieval.method: Verified NASA PGDA download or Git LFS.

processing.method: GeoTIFF scale 0.00004 and offset 0 are applied; values are compared with SPICE/LOLA-derived long-term estimates.

entries.dataset: NASA PGDA Earth visibility truth raster
entries.description: Product 69 fraction of hourly epochs where any part of Earth's disc is above terrain.

retrieval.method: Verified NASA PGDA download; validation-only input, not API runtime data.

processing.method: Held-out comparison against locally generated SPICE/LOLA Earth-disc visibility.

entries.description: Leap seconds, body constants, lunar frames/orientation and DE430 solar-system ephemeris used by the physics engine.

source.title: NAIF generic kernels
source.version_or_date: Kernel-specific filenames and SHA-256 values are in src/acquire/nasa_products.py and src/acquire/verify_data.py.

retrieval.method: Git LFS or verified NAIF download.

processing.method: spiceypy loads kernels; ME/PA frame transforms and topocentric azimuth/elevation are computed locally.

entries.description: Cached apparent Sun/Earth observer-table azimuth/elevation used for the independent cross-check.

source.title: Horizons API
source.version_or_date: Query and retrieval timestamp are recorded in data/validation/horizons_crosscheck.json.

retrieval.date: Recorded in each cached response header and generated report.
retrieval.method: Programmatic API query; cached text responses retained as reference data.

processing.method: Objects 10 and 399, center coord@301, geodetic user site, MEAN_ME, 0 km altitude, UTC interval 2026-11-15 through 2026-12-14T12:00Z, 6 h step, observer quantity 4, AIRLESS, degrees.

entries.dataset: Derived SPICE tracks, geometry and validation outputs
entries.description: Locally generated tracks, horizons, countdowns, illumination comparisons and API fixtures.

source.organization: Local application processing using cited NASA/JPL/USGS inputs
source.title: Reproducible derived products
source.version_or_date: Generated per artifact; code revision is recorded by Git.

retrieval.method: Local Python modules; no external source is claimed for derived values.

processing.method: Inputs, coordinate conventions, constants and transformations are documented in source modules and docs/SCIENTIFIC_BASIS.md.

unsupported_or_ambiguous_items: Peregrine, Blue Ghost 1, IM-3, CP-12 and IM-4 catalog coordinates are explicitly destination/region references without an independently established exact-coordinate source.
Nassau, Nobile, Shackleton Connecting Ridge and other planned targets are feature/region references, not landing points.
Some historical landing records cite alternate coordinate solutions; the selected coordinate and alternative are both described in data/missions.json.
CP-12 termination currently relies on a secondary SpaceNews citation and needs human confirmation against an official NASA/Draper release.
not_claimed: Automated validation is not scientific approval.
Artemis anchor coordinates are not NASA-published region centroids.
Locally generated tiles, tracks, API payloads and geometry are not NASA datasets.
